nso] jkT; pquko vk;qDr STATE ELECTION COMMISSION NATIONAL CAPITAL TERRITORY OF DELHI NOTIFICATION Delhi, the 28th April, 2025 No. F. 4 BYE (1)/SEC/LAW/2025/19212.—WHEREAS the following vacancies have occurred in the Municipal Corporation of Delhi as shown against each ward due to the resignation of the sitting Councillors:- -- 2 of 3 -- [PART IV DELHI GAZETTE : EXTRAORDINARY 3 Sl. No. No. & Name of Ward Status of Reservation No. & Name of Assembly Constituency in which the ward is comprised 1 2 3 4 1. 35- Mundka GENERAL 08 - Mundka 2 56-Shalimar Bagh-B WOMAN 14 - Shalimar Bagh 3 65-Ashok Vihar WOMAN 17 - Wazirpur 4 74-Chandni Chowk GENERAL 20 - ChandniChowk 5 76- Chandni Mahal GENERAL 21 - Matia Mahal 6 120-Dwarka B WOMAN 34 -Matiala 7 128- Dichaon Kalan WOMAN 35 - Najafgarh 8 139-Naraina GENERAL 39 - Rajender Nagar 9 163-SangamVihar-A GENERAL 47 - Deoli 10 164 -DakshinPuri SC 47 - Deoli 11 173-Greater Kailash WOMAN 50 - Greater Kailash 12 198-Vinod Nagar GENERAL 57 - Patparganj AND WHEREAS bye-elections to the above mentioned wards shall be held to elect Councillors to fill the casual vacancies in the Municipal Corporation of Delhi, in accordance with the provisions of Delhi Municipal Corporation Act, 1957 as amended till now and the rules made thereunder. AND WHEREAS the State Election Commissioner of the National Capital Territory of Delhi is satisfied that instead of preparing fresh electoral rolls for the aforesaid wards for use in the bye-elections, it would be sufficient to adopt the electoral rolls of the respective Assembly Constituencies of the National Capital Territory of Delhi, as are comprised within the above-mentioned wards of the Municipal Corporation of Delhi, and for the time being are in force and as relate to the above-mentioned wards, for the purpose of the aforesaid bye-elections, as the electoral rolls for the Assembly Constituencies have since been revised by the Chief Electoral Officer, Delhi, with reference to 01/01/2025 as the qualifying date. Preparation of fresh electoral rolls for the above-said wards by this Commission would entail long time besides incurring expenditure in this respect, which could be safely avoided. NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred upon the Election Commission under the proviso to Section 7E of the Delhi Municipal Corporation Act, 1957 as amended till date read with Rule 27 of the Delhi Municipal Corporation (Preparation of Electoral Rolls) Rules, 1975, I, Dr. Vijay Dev, State Election Commissioner of the National Capital Territory of Delhi, hereby direct that the electoral rolls of such Assembly Constituencies, for the time being in force, as relate to the above-mentioned 12 wards of the Municipal Corporation of Delhi, shown above against each in column 4, shall be the electoral rolls for the said Municipal Wards, for the purpose of the ensuing bye- elections to the said wards of the Municipal Corporation of Delhi. Further, the Supplementary electoral rolls prepared by the office of the Chief Electoral Officer, Govt. of NCT of Delhi, under section 22 & 23 of the Representation of the People Act 1950, as these exists on the last date fixed for filing nominations for the aforesaid bye-elections, shall also be included in the electoral roll of respective wards as adopted by this Commission, for purpose of said bye-elections. DR.
